newsitem.title: USA: Safeskin files for secondary share offer.
newsitem.headline: Safeskin files for secondary share offer.

text.p: Safeskin Corp filed Wednesday with the Securities and Exchange Commission for a secondary offering of up to 3.2 million common shares.
The shares will be sold by co-chairman Neil Braverman; chairman, president and chief executive Richard Jaffe; and chairman emeritus Irving Jaffe, the company said.
Braverman plans to sell up to 2.0 million shares, Richard Jaffe 200,000 shares and Irving Jaffe 1.0 million shares.

The sale, when completed, will reduce Braverman's stake to 8.35 percent from 16.0 percent, Richard Jaffe to 5.75 percent from from 6.52 percent and Irving Jaffe, to 5.25 percent from 9.14 percent, it said.
The offering will be made through Smith Barney Inc and Merrill Lynch & Co Inc. The underwriters have an overallotment option for up to 480,000 additional shares
Safeskin is a San Diego, Calif.,-based maker of disposable latex medical examination gloves.
